LanguageData.VGE_AstrofuelPodLauncher.label: astrofuel pod launcher
LanguageData.VGE_AstrofuelPodLauncher.description: A compact fueling port for launching one transport pod. Utilizing highly efficient astrofuel, this launcher is significantly smaller than traditional designs. Pod launchers can launch as a group - but the launchers must be placed adjacent to each other.
LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod.label: escape pod
LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod.description: A floor-mounted, pre-fueled single use escape pod designed to quickly evacuate a single colonist with whatever gear they happened to carry at the time. The escape pod launches immediately upon the crewmember entering it, and will launch directly down to surface. Needs to be placed on gravship substructure. Only works in orbit.
LanguageData.VGE_VacuumWarningLight.label: vacuum warning light
LanguageData.VGE_VacuumWarningLight.description: An electrical warning lamp that emits flashing orange light if the vacuum in the room reaches dangerous levels. Undrafted crewmembers will make their way out of the room when the warning light turns on. Draws power directly from the grav engine.
